The following events took place in '''138 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Darth Krayt]] [[Assault on the Temple of the Sith|returned]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and reclaimed his position as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] by [[Death/Legends|slaying]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]].
*[[Third Jedi Purge]] resumed.
**[[Mission to Daluuj]].
*[[Darth Maladi]] was captured by the [[Empire-in-exile]].
*[[Hogrum Chalk]] was secretly working for [[Morlish Veed]].
*[[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]] was revealed as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for Emperor [[Roan Fel|Fel]] and joined the Empire-in-exile.
*[[Fehlaaur'aitel'loro]] took Calixte's place as the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]].
*Darth Krayt unleashed an [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attack]] on the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] on [[Taivas]] and revealed his [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]] to his allies and enemies.
*Evacuation of the Hidden Temple by the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]].
*Final [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|battle]] with the [[One Sith]] on Coruscant.
*[[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] falls.
*The [[Third Jedi Purge]] ends.
*The [[Second Imperial Civil War]] ends.
*[[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] formed.<ref name="legwar6" />
*Beginning of [[Darth Wredd]]'s [[Darth Wredd's insurgency|Insurgency]].
